name: Get email senders
description: Get email senders. Retrieves a list of all email senders from your Brevo account with optional filtering. **Use this to:** - Get all available senders for email campaign setup - Find sender details including ID, name, and email address - Filter senders by IP address for dedicated IP users - Filter senders by domain for domain-specific configurations - Monitor sender configuration and status **Key information returned:** - Sender details (ID, name, email address)…
